description: The plot illustrates MRR@10 performance as a function of the number of queries used during inference (S), showing four DPR variants. The x-axis is labeled “Number of queries used during inference (S).” on a linear scale, spanning 1 to 10 with integer tick marks at each value. The y-axis is labeled “MRR@10” on a linear scale, ranging from 33.0 to 36.0 with regularly spaced ticks every 0.5. A black solid horizontal line (no markers) labeled “DPR w/o query” stays essentially constant across all S at roughly 34.2. A red solid line with circular markers labeled “DPR w/ corpus expansion” rises from about 35.1 at S=1 to about 35.5 at S=2, then continues with small increases and minor fluctuations, reaching about 35.8 by S=10 (with values around 35.6–35.8 from roughly S=4 onward). A green solid line with upward-triangle markers labeled “DPR w/ document expansion” stays near 34.8–34.9 across the range, starting around 34.75 at S=1 and ending around 34.85 at S=10, with a slight bump near S=6 (around 34.9). A blue solid line with star markers labeled “DPR w/ asymmetric expansion” fluctuates around the mid-34s, starting near 34.75 at S=1, peaking around 35.0 at S=2 and again near 35.0 at S=5, then trending downward after about S=6 to end near 34.35 at S=10.
